name: Andrzej Halicki, Matjaž Nemec - § 79, après le point l - Am 151
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2026
part_text: (l a) Recalls that Parliament must focus on its legislative and budgetary functions; considers that maintaining an extensive network of liaison offices in the Member States constitutes disproportionate expenditure with limited effectiveness; stresses that Parliament should set an example by reducing non-essential administrative spending;
